The '''V-53 Hydromancer''' was a multi-sailed civilian pleasure [[Yacht (aquatic)/Legends|yacht]] that measured 23 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length. Consisting of both above decks and below decks areas, the yacht was designed to be crewed by six beings, although it could be manned by three if needed. Room was allocated for two passengers, and there was storage for 1 [[Metric ton/Legends|metric ton]] of cargo. The V-53 could reach speeds of 70 [[Kilometer/Legends|Kilometers]] an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]].<ref name="TSR" />

Multi-millionaire playboy [[Seth Cambriel]] owned a V-53 Hydromancer, the ''[[Cambus Gale]]'', on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Spira/Legends|Spira]] which he had converted into a racing yacht by reshaping the hull, rerigging the sails and upgrading its capabilities.<ref name="TSR" />
